author: Fixture Reporter
content:
Nvidia has appointed a new head of European developer relations, with the appointment taking effect on October 1. The role will coordinate regional developer support, training and community programs.

The incoming leader will oversee collaboration with local developer groups and prepare the next year's workshop calendar. The company will communicate program details through its regional developer channels.

The appointment concerns organization of Nvidia's developer-relations activities in Europe.
headline: Nvidia Appoints New Head Of European Developer Relations
summary: Nvidia has appointed a new European developer-relations leader, effective October 1, to coordinate regional training and support programs.
